abstract: The authors present a case of a 33-year-old infertile woman with coincidental dermoid cyst and ovarian endometriosis in the same ovary. She was admitted to the Clinic because of cystic tumor of the left adnexa. Transvaginal ultrasound (TVUS) examination found a bilocular tumor of complex structure on the left ovary. Video-laparoscopy was also performed. On the left ovary, two adjacent cystic formations were found. Laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy was performed and a surgical specimen was sent for histopathologic analysis. The diagnosis was a dermoid cyst and ovarian endometriosis. Without complications, the patient was released from the hospital. The patient was treated with an analogue of gonadotropin releasing hormone (GnRH) for three months as a preparation for in vitro fertilization (IVF).
abstract_ja: 33歳の不妊女性が、左付属器の嚢胞性腫瘤のため当院を受診した症例を提示する。経腟超音波検査（TVUS）で、左卵巣に複雑な構造を有する二房性腫瘍が認められた。腹腔鏡検査も施行された。左卵巣には隣接する2つの嚢胞性病変が認められた。腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢胞摘出術を施行し、外科的検体は病理組織学的解析に提出された。診断は類皮嚢腫と卵巣子宮内膜症であった。合併症なく患者は退院した。患者は体外受精（IVF）の準備として、3か月間ゴナドトロピン放出ホルモン（GnRH）アナログによる治療を受けた。
